## Agent Network Reconnaissance Report — 22 Feb 2026

### Active Protocol Standards

| Protocol | Origin | Type | Status |
|----------|--------|------|--------|
| **MCP** (Model Context Protocol) | Anthropic | Tool/Resource | Broad adoption 2025, evolving rapidly |
| **A2A** (Agent2Agent) | Google (Apr 2025) | Agent-to-Agent | Active development, IBM supporting |
| **ACP** (Agent Communication Protocol) | Emerging | Interop | Listed in 2026 guides |
| **ANP** (Agent Network Protocol) | Open | Multi-agent | Mentioned in multi-agent guides |
| **AG-UI** | Open | UI/Real-time | UI protocol for agents |
| **AP2** | Emerging | Interop | Listed in protocol comparisons |
| **OAP** (Open Agent Protocol) | Open-source | Agent-to-agent/tool | Emerging standard |
| **W3C AI Agent Protocol CG** | W3C | Official standard | Specs expected 2026-2027 |

### Marketplace/Platform Discovery

- **Visa Agentic Commerce** — Agent-driven payments ecosystem emerging (Dec 2025)
- **Agentic AI Platforms** — Truefoundry, AI Gateways for enterprise workflow orchestration
- **OpenAI AGENTS.md** — Specification pushed by OpenAI alongside AAIF participation
- **Agentic Browsers** — Mid-2025 emergence for computer-use agents

### Communities

- **r/AgentsOfAI** (Reddit) — Active protocol discussion
- **Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)** — Industry consortium with OpenAI participation

### Notes

No dedicated "agent relay services" or standalone agent marketplaces detected in current search. Protocol landscape still fragmented—no single standard dominates. W3C community group is key watchlist item for 2026-2027 standardization.
